summary: Sponsors DB migration + Local ads + Advertiser lead + Affiliate + Local-offer Stripe checkout ALL PASS. Backend: 24/24 pytest PASS (test_sponsors_and_local.py). Frontend: home renders Partner Spots with Ton's Hauling featured (phone 402-810-6319, ad-slot-local testid) and Featured Sponsors strip with ALDI/Costco/Kroger (sponsor-box-deal/sponsor/weekly), all served from DB. Tapping Local Special card (local-special testid) opens advertise-form; filling advertise-business + advertise-contact + advertise-message and tapping advertise-submit shows advertise-success 'Thanks!' overlay. NOTE: on the first submit attempt the POST /api/advertisers hit a 429 because the pytest suite (rate_limit 5/60s test) had just consumed slots on the same IP; waiting 65s and resubmitting reproduced the happy path — the app itself handles the flow correctly. Existing RN-web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents, Image.resizeMode) still present as reported in iteration_7 — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN web; use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card) and /app/frontend/src/components/LocalSpecial.tsx:90-93. Warning fires repeatedly.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Fires on many screens.
'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — likely from LocalSpecial.tsx:96 (styles.photo has resizeMode: 'cover') and possibly other components.

action_items: Optional: replace remaining shadow* style props with boxShadow (theme.ts, LocalSpecial.tsx card) and move resizeMode from StyleSheet to prop on Image components to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.

Optional: consider a friendlier 429 message in AdvertiseForm — currently a rate-limited submit silently leaves the form open. If AdvertiseForm swallows the error, users may not know why nothing happened.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:775 seed_sponsors uses $set + $setOnInsert with (placement,key) unique combination — idempotent, safe to re-run on every startup. Verified: no duplicates found.
server.py:786 GET /api/sponsors excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} — good, avoids serialization crashes.
server.py:1060 POST /api/advertisers rate-limited 5/60s and persists to db.advertisers with a UUID id — matches spec.
server.py:1044 GET /api/local-ads normalizes city via _norm_city (strips non-alpha) so 'omaha, NE' matches 'omaha' — correct.
server.py:1089 POST /api/local-offer/checkout resolves price server-side from LOCAL_ADS[ad_id].offer.price — no client trust, good.
server.py:197 amazon_search_url always appends tag=Jimboneys-20 — verified end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Partner Spots + Ton's Hauling featured + Featured Sponsors strip + advertise-form open + submit -> advertise-success all pass)

seed_data_creation: Test-created advertisers/payment_transactions rows are cleaned up in test_cleanup fixture. Sponsors seed is auto-managed by server startup (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://whohas-app.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest tests/test_sponsors_and_local.py -v`. If the rate-limit test flakes (429 not seen in 10 attempts), the previous test class already exhausted slots — wait 60s and rerun. Frontend advertise-submit flow shares the same 5/60s IP bucket as the backend suite — if you run pytest immediately before playwright on the same IP, the first UI submit will 429 and advertise-success won't appear. Either wait 60s or run playwright first.
